title: Confirmed Helper No-Show
rule: For a confirmed no-show, verify check-in status, begin replacement search after 15 minutes, provide a progress update to the customer, and escalate when no eligible replacement can arrive before the customer deadline.
refund_rule: Refunds up to INR 300 may be processed automatically. Amounts above INR 300 require operations-manager approval.

title: Helper Delay
rule: Contact the helper, calculate expected arrival, update the customer, and begin a replacement search if the delay threatens the customer's stated deadline.
refund_rule: Any compensation must follow the configured approval threshold.
